scope: Extend explicit-owner raw SUN transaction coverage from ASCII output to Binary DXF output.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored AC1027 ASCII DXF generated during the test
source.profile: One generated VPORT table row references one typed SUN and retained raw SUN carrier with matching owner handle. The same imported source is serialized in ASCII and Binary; no fixture file is committed.

implementation.change: The existing dedicated owner-override allocation test now sweeps both ASCII and Binary output using separate destinations and per-codec calibration bytes.
implementation.method: For each codec, inject std::bad_alloc at every reached allocation inside the explicit-owner raw SUN callback; verify export failure, previous destination bytes, caller raw record preservation, same-adapter retry to byte-identical codec output, and fresh typed owner readback.

limitations: Generated transaction/transport evidence only; physical producer prevalence and native SUN behavior remain unqualified.
The test uses one VPORT/SUN owner profile and does not qualify other SUN relationships or raw-carrier payload variants.

planImpact.completedSlice: Binary allocation rollback/retry/readback for the raw SUN explicit-owner-override overload, alongside the existing ASCII sweep.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue auditing distinct public writer overloads, record variants, and variable-size profiles without reopening already-covered routes absent a new failure.
